text:
Anna: Heads-up: planned cross-service cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Runtime -> v2.4.0 canary then ramp. Need API pin, console smoke, router header-split weights, and runtime pin. Release notes: https://intra.redwood/release/2.4.0
Liam: Got it, I'll pin API for canary (5%) at 22:50 and watch error budget. Plan: 5/25/50/100 with 5m health windows.
Jordana: Console preflight: run auth/login, route-list, editor-open, eval-run in staging at 22:30. Prod smoke at 22:55. Will report failures here.
Kevin: Router: staged config applied in staging. Prod will update weighted routes + header-split. Abort criteria: >0.5% 5xx sustained 5m after routing change.
Emma: Ops rollback criteria in release notes: 1) sustained 5xx >1% for 10m; 2) p95 latency +200ms for 5m; 3) critical auth failures. Runbook link included.
Anna: Rollback signal is explicit: post here + @oncall + run `/deploy rollback <service> <version>`; keep comms short.
Liam: Do we need a console feature flag flip?
Jordana: Yes: feature flag `new-runtime-support` enabled for canary only. I'll flip after API pin.
Emma: Ops dashboard up: https://grafana.redwood/d/xXy/runtime-cutover. We'll watch SLOs and error budget.
Kevin: Router will mirror API canary weight. If API is 5% then router routes 5% to runtime-canary pool.
Anna: Preflight pin example:
```
/deploy pin --service runtime --version v2.4.0 --wave canary --note "2.4.0 canary cross-service"
```
Liam: Pinning API in staging now.
deploy-bot: executed: /deploy pin --service api --version v1.13.0 --wave canary by Liam at 2024-05-16T22:50:12Z 1 status: OK, pinned to 5% canary.
Jordana: Console flag flipped in staging, smoke results: auth ok, list ok, eval-run 0.8s.
Emma: Staging metrics look clean. No elevated 5xx. P95 +8ms.
Kevin: Router staged mirror applied.
Anna: We'll start prod pin at 23:00 UTC. Reposting rollback triggers here for visibility. If anyone sees anomalies, post and ping @oncall.
Liam: Monitoring API error budget and will post per-wave.
Jordana: Will paste console errors if any.
Kevin: If rollback required, router revert command:
`/deploy pin --service router --version <prev> --wave full` then set weights back to 100% old.
Emma: Ops will run evasive traffic tests after canary to validate hedges.
deploy-bot: scheduled: runtime v2.4.0 canary rollout at 2024-05-16T23:00:00Z. Health window 5m per weight increase. Auto-rollback disabled (manual-only) per request.
Anna: Final: release notes include changelog + rollback runbook. Thanks all :rocket:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled at 22:55 UTC to @eng-release for final go/no-go ping.
